source.title: The NAS Parallel Benchmarks
source.reference: NASA Ames NAS Technical Report RNR-94-007, March 1994, §2.2.3
source.algorithm_attribution: Sparse conjugate-gradient inner solves within inverse-power eigenvalue iteration
source.implementation_status: bounded clean-room core profile; canonical makea matrix generation is omitted

contract.profile: Run sparse CSR matrix-vector products and bounded CG inner solves inside repeated inverse-power eigenvalue iterations.
contract.initial_vector: x is the all-ones vector for the first outer iteration; each following vector is the prior CG solution normalized by its Euclidean norm.
contract.inner_solve: Start z=0, r=x, p=r. Perform at most cg_steps standard CG updates; stop early when the recursive residual norm is at most 1e-14 times its initial norm. Compute the reported residual explicitly as ||x-Az||.
contract.outer_update: For each outer iteration record shift + 1/(x^T z) and ||x-Az||, then set x=z/||z||.

input.encoding: [n, outer_iterations, cg_steps, shift_micro, nnz, row_ptr[n+1], column_index[nnz], value_micro[nnz]]
input.matrix_format: zero-based CSR with strictly increasing, unique column indices in each row; stored values are nonzero
input.matrix_domain: exactly symmetric; every diagonal is positive and strictly greater than the sum of absolute off-diagonal entries in its row, certifying positive definiteness

output.encoding: little-endian IEEE-754 binary64 values; two values for each outer iteration

workspace.meaning: Six 32-element binary64 CG and inverse-power work vectors; the CSR arrays are read directly from the input.
